a feature row prediction_timestamp differs from D 16:30 America/New_York
any NaN appears in development features
F duplicate check fails: sw_count_1 != event__article_count for any stock
a news, sentiment, or event file hash mismatches its record

matrix comparison count is not exactly 3828 / 132 / 132
known_limitations: Event labels are keyword-rule output, not ground truth. PRODUCT rule contains Apple-specific keywords (iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, App Store); product events are under-detected for non-Apple stocks.
Cumulative sentiment features are non-stationary (Phase 8 finding); issue amplified by scale differences across stocks in the panel.
Symbol tags come from the provider and are not checked for relevance; an article tagged with many stocks may be marginal to each.
Revision-time availability rule (avail = max(created_at, updated_at)) may delay information; revision lag unmeasured.
Provider may silently edit article text without updating updated_at; such edits are undetectable.
Provider coverage changes over time are indistinguishable from real variation in news volume.
Fixed model parameters, no hyperparameter tuning, one news provider, one sentiment model.
FinBERT run-to-run determinism has not been verified (Phase 8 finding).
39% of AAPL articles were classified as OTHER event type.
A null result in Phase 11B covers these specific news representations, not news information in general.
